name: Hyperemu
description: A functional emulator for the ARMv7 (expanded to include x86 and RISC-V) architecture written in Rust. Capable of decoding and executing ARM instructions, managing memory registers, and simulating system behavior for educational and testing purposes. Live demo available at https://robby-cell.github.io/hyperemu-gui/.

name: Variant
description: A header only implementation of std::variant that works for C++14.
codeSnippet: auto str = Visit([](const auto& v) { return std::to_string(v); }, v);

name: Remindify
description: Calendar app that functions like a social media app. Users send messages to a chat, and if event information is given, it adds it to a calendar. Can be exported as ICS.

name: Git App
description: A simple git client that allows you to manage git repositories through a graphical interface.

name: Space
description: A basic implementation of a string container (like std::string). Features small string optimization (SSO), custom allocator support, and iterators.

name: Assert
description: Readable and powerful C++ assertions. Simple framework allowing testing with detailed error messages, expressive assertions, and structured test organization.
